description: Fictional pro player media-day portraits. Every player is invented; prompts forbid resemblance to real people.
style: Professional esports media-day portrait photograph. Chest-up framing, subject centered, shoulders angled slightly, head turned to face the camera, eyes level with the lens. Seamless dark charcoal studio backdrop with a soft gradient. Lighting: large softbox key light from camera left, gentle fill from the right, cool blue-white rim light from behind. Shot on an 85mm lens at f/2.8, sharp focus on the eyes, natural skin texture, no retouching gloss, photorealistic editorial sports photography. The jersey is a modern sublimated esports team jersey with an abstract geometric crest on the chest. No words, letters, numbers, sponsor logos or real brand marks anywhere in the image. No headset, no props. The person is entirely fictional and must not resemble any real person or public figure.
